name: Aquatic Invasive Species Grants to Great Lakes Tribes (Great Lakes Restoration Initiative)
summary: Small US federal grants for Great Lakes tribes, or an organisation a tribe designates, to write or carry out tribal plans for preventing, detecting and controlling aquatic invasive species in the Great Lakes basin.
reporting: Recipients file federal financial reports and programme performance reports, on the schedule set in the notice of award.

calls.label: Fiscal Year 2026 notice (F26AS00084)

status.quote: All pre-proposals (including Project Narrative, Budget Narrative) must be received no later than 11:59 pm Eastern Standard Time 60 days after this NOFO is posted to grants.gov.

calls.note: Pre-proposals go by email within 60 days of the notice's posting; invited full proposals follow, with grants.gov listing 31 December 2026 as its closing date.

administered_by.quote: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Notice of Funding Opportunity F26AS00084 Aquatic Invasive Species Grants to Great Lakes Tribes

applicant_types.quote: Eligible Applicants Others (see text field entitled "Additional Information on Eligibility" for clarification) Unrestricted (i.e., open to any type of entity above), subject to any clarification in text field entitled "Additional Information on Eligibility"

geography.quote: All tribal grants will be awarded based on a competitive process for which only Great Lakes tribes or their designee are eligible.

access.quote: All pre-proposals will be submitted via email to: fws3_fisheries_grants@fws.gov.

window.quote: Pre-proposals will be ranked to determine funding levels for each at which time applicants will be notified via email of approved funding amounts.

co_finance_required.quote: Cost sharing or matching funds are not required to be eligible for this grant opportunity.

reporting.quote: Submit Federal Financial reports and Program Performance reports.
